content: Given an NMT model, we first generated six-way pseudo-parallel data by translating monolingual data. For the sake of comparability, we used the identical monolingual sentences sampled in Section SECREF34 . Then, we further fine-tuned the given model on the mixture of the generated pseudo-parallel data and the original parallel data, following the same over-sampling procedure in Section SECREF34 . We repeated these steps five times.
